metadata.description: Curated subset of the experiment-24 artifact (iteration 5, Step 1: transplanting Qwen3-8B-Base plan states into Qwen3-8B) for code_demo.ipynb. examples = 100 CRN slots of the transplant_confirmation dataset (T14 and T03, S2 slots j 10-19 x W1-W5); every predict_<arm>/output value is 'label|pass' of a program generated by Qwen/Qwen3-8B (bf16, RTX 4090) and labelled by the iteration-4 label worker. metadata = the frozen commits, catalogues and reference numbers the analysis code needs.

commit0.definitions:
Frozen analysis code (sha256 committed in COMMIT #0): statistics and the pre-registered decision rules for
Claim B (transplant reopens the base repertoire), Claim D (de-sharpening push) and the reverse interchange.

Definitions (also restated in predictions/commit0.json):
- correct(r)       := passed every hidden test AND a program was extracted (label != 'invalid').
- catalogue label  := a label in the task's catalogue; 'other' and 'invalid' are never catalogue labels.
- off-default share (among correct) := n(correct, catalogue label != default_t) / n(correct); 'other' stays in the
                      denominator only.
- y(slot)          := 1[correct AND catalogue label != default_t] (per CRN slot; the McNemar outcome).
- default_t        := modal correct label of the S1 twin if its share among correct >= 0.6, else None.
- beta_t           := off-default share of the BASE_CHAT programs w.r.t. default_t (fewer than 20 correct even after
                      the top-up -> the same share over parseable attempts, flagged ATTEMPT).
- r_t              := the most frequent correct non-default catalogue label of BASE_CHAT (ties: more attempts, then
                      alphabetical).
- strata           := BASE-DIVERSE beta >= 0.20; BASE-COLLAPSED beta < 0.05; INTERMEDIATE otherwise.
Tests: one-sided exact McNemar = binomial(b, b + c, 1/2) upper tail on the discordant pairs of y; Holm over the
decisive family; Wilson intervals for shares, Newcombe (hybrid score) intervals for differences.

commit1.lambda_selection_rule: lambda*_t = argmax correct off-default share (among correct) over lambda in {0.25, 0.5, 1} with pass >= 0.8 x pass(twin S1); ties -> smaller; none -> UNTESTED
commit1.mr_breakage_rule: MR(lambda*) BROKEN if pass < 0.8 x twin (S1, MR(lambda*) cell when run, else the nearest MR grid point); lambda' = the largest grid lambda with an unbroken MR; none -> ISO(1)

geometry.note: within-band panels (S18, S23) put T(lambda) points on the instruct-base segment by construction; S27 and R are informative

reference_full_run.note: results/*.json of the full run (all 5 decisive + 7 descriptive tasks; Holm over the 11 decisive p-values) for comparison with the demo recomputation

branches: specificity failed (READ moves or collapsed tasks move)

stats.note: the template-cluster bootstrap with 5 clusters is anti-conservative; coverage is reported

    sorted_items = sorted(count.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))
    result = []
    for i in range(k):
        result.append(sorted_items[i][0])
    return result
